hook: Stop calling resizing part of the job.

facebook.text:
Stop calling resizing part of the job.

You already solved the message and the design once. Rebuilding square, story, and wide versions adds labor without adding strategy, and dragging text and logos into new dimensions is a pile of tiny decisions that pull you away from actual marketing work.

Poaster generates everything together. One input produces every format you need at once, so a solo marketer gets the time back and the graphics still match.

Swipe for the five-slide version. poaster.co is free to try, 3 downloads before you create an account.
